$description: Backdrop photographs for mock UI stages. `pnpm assets:build <outDir>` renders every `ready` entry; `pending-source` entries have no original in assets/source yet. Originals are never hotlinked at runtime. `dominantColor` is written by the build.

backdrops.notes: Motion-blurred poppies and yellow wildflowers. Original is Lyra's sign-in photo (lyra repo apps/web/public/brand/login-hero.jpg); lyra-landing's field-*.webp are crops of it. Photographer and license are not recorded in either repository; confirm before listing it on /credits.

Download the original once from Unsplash, save it as source/arion-meadow.jpg (≤ about 1 MB, at least 2400 px wide), record the photographer, set the focal point and switch status to ready. Unsplash serves the photo page behind a bot challenge to automated clients, so the original and photographer could not be retrieved from the agent environment; download it manually.

backdrops.author: DL314 Lin
backdrops.notes: Yellow flowers and green leaves swirled by camera rotation. Downloaded once from images.unsplash.com (photo-1749864665887-b89a4d505053) at 2560 px; never hotlinked.

backdrops.author: Travis Fish
backdrops.notes: Star trails over silhouetted trees, a long exposure. Downloaded once from images.unsplash.com (photo-1763464912904-74ef05b79062) at 2400 px; never hotlinked. The focal point keeps the treetops at the bottom of the wide crop.

backdrops.author: Eugene Golovesov
backdrops.notes: Pink gladiolus over dark green foliage, swept by a slow pan. Copied from the Arion site sources (Arion apps/site/assets/backdrops/gladiolus.jpg, 2400 x 3626); never hotlinked. Dark enough for light type at the bottom of the card without a heavy scrim.
